summary_for_children: Surah Luqman tells of a wise man, Luqman, who gave his son advice: never worship anything besides Allah, be grateful to parents, pray, be patient, don't be proud, walk gently and lower your voice.
environment_concept: A great rock with a tiny seed beside it (31:16), a path for walking gently (31:19) and a shore with trees and a pen (31:27).
architecture_and_scenery: Courtyard garden with a central rock, a mustard plant, slow paths, and a shoreline where the sea stretches like ink.

palette.lighting: Warm afternoon in a family garden

unique_world.visual_theme: A garden path with fig and olive trees where a goat, a cat and a dove rest

primary_mechanic.text: At each animal, pass on a message at the right loudness: hold Speak and the voice needle rises, let go and it sinks. Keep it in the green band for 2.5 seconds and the message is heard; past the red line the animal is startled and settles again before you try more gently. Each listener is more easily startled than the one before (31:19, lower your voice). Luqman and his son are not shown; his advice is read from the verses.

unique_world.narrative_structure: Goat, cat and dove along the path, then the mustard seed reading
world_assets: voice meter panel with green band and red line
environment_behaviour: heard animals show a soft gold ring
the needle and the "Heard" timer update live

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: A Father's Wise Advice
story_library.children_narration: Luqman was blessed with wisdom. He advised his son to worship Allah alone, be grateful, respect his parents, pray, practice patience, and avoid arrogance. He also encouraged him to be moderate in how he walked and spoke. These lessons can guide us in everyday life.

world_idea.title: Luqman's Wisdom Workshop
world_idea.description: Explore a storybook learning home with practical activities about kindness, gratitude, and thoughtful speech. Luqman's advice is presented through verified narration rather than invented conversations.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
